periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of both patches are oriented at approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/Ellipsoid, with the vertical dimension approximately 1.5 times the horizontal dimension.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, extending significantly below the horizontal eye line toward the zygomatic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral spacing on the cranial vault, approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Open oral cavity revealing mandibular dentition and a green bamboo stalk held in the mouth.
